subject: A
symptom: pdl_check --device both: 'CUDA requested but not available'; ctest check_cuda fails although nvidia-smi and a standalone nvcc test see the GPU
root_cause: apt installed a stale libcuda.so.580 in /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu that shadows the WSL2 driver library in /usr/lib/wsl/lib
fix_summary: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib first (documented in the setup script output); preflight in pdlbench makes the failure loud

subject: A
symptom: compute_gemm stuck 22 min: cpu-naive ran at n=2048 (38.7 s per repetition) and n=4096 was next
root_cause: max-naive is a GFLOP threshold per repetition; the config used 1024 as if it were a matrix size, so nothing was skipped

subject: A
symptom: cpu-omp GEMM (12 threads) measured 31 GFLOP/s = same as cpu-blocked (1 thread); standalone run gave 170 GFLOP/s
root_cause: pdl_ctx_init called omp_set_num_threads(n), which is process-global; --verify creates a 1-thread reference context so every later cpu-omp context in the same process ran on 1 thread
fix_summary: removed the global call (thread count is already in ctx->num_threads and every OpenMP region has num_threads(nt))

subject: A
symptom: cuBLAS GEMM measured 0.38-0.65 TFLOP/s at n=512..2048 but 5.4 TFLOP/s at n=4096 (4096 faster than 2048 in wall time); standalone loop gave 3.4-5.7 TFLOP/s
root_cause: fixed warm-up of 2 repetitions of a sub-millisecond kernel; the GPU idles at a low clock while the CPU runs the verification and needs hundreds of ms of load to boost
fix_summary: time-based GPU warm-up (min 0.5 s) in time_it

subject: A
symptom: 12 OpenMP threads were spread over 8 WSL 'cores' (vCPU 12-15 included) instead of vCPU 0-11
root_cause: WSL2 reports 8 cores x 2 threads for the 6P+4E CPU; OMP_PLACES=cores therefore has 8 places

subject: A
symptom: cannot tell whether a result was taken under Balanced or High performance power plan or with background load; P/E core pinning cannot be verified
root_cause: under WSL2 the Windows host schedules the vCPUs, so inside the VM every vCPU runs at the same speed (measured ~30 GFLOP/s on cpu 0-15) and the host power plan affects clocks
fix_summary: manifest.json now records the Windows power plan, idle load, LD_LIBRARY_PATH and a pinning note; the report states the limitation
